json.description: Map of term → definition. Every <dfn> on the page whose text (or `data-aed-glossary` attribute) matches a term gets a hover/tap tooltip.

data.description: Term marker. Either let the addon match `dfn` text against the glossary keys (case-insensitive), or set `data-aed-glossary` to override the lookup key.

data-aed-glossary.description: Lookup key. Defaults to the element's text content if omitted.
